title: Single Pyramid Magnets: Dy5 Pyramids with Slow Magnetic Relaxation to 40 K

material_class.structural_family: oxo-centered Ln5 square-based pyramid alkoxide cluster

synthesis.procedure: All manipulations used Schlenk and glove-box techniques under dry nitrogen. Potassium metal was dissolved in 1:1 (v/v) HOiPr/toluene, then a 1.0 mmol cm−3 H2O solution in the same solvent mixture was added. After 1 h, anhydrous DyCl3 was added. The mixture was stirred for at least 48 h, filtered through dry celite, and the volatiles were removed in vacuo. The solid was dissolved in n-hexane and stored at −20 °C to give crystalline 1. Two polymorphs (orthorhombic Pbca isostructural with [Er5O(OiPr)13] and a new monoclinic C2 cell) form as pure batches.

properties.summary: Compound 1 is a Dy5 SMM. Room-temperature χMT matches five uncoupled DyIII ions; χMT falls on cooling, with possible weak antiferromagnetic coupling. Magnetization at 1.8 K approaches ~27 μB with a very narrow hysteresis. AC susceptibility in zero DC field shows slow relaxation to ~40 K (χ″ maximum at 41 K for 1.4 kHz). Arrhenius fit above 35 K gives ΔE = 528 ± 11 K and τ0 = 4.7 × 10−10 s; a second, cautionary low-T process gives ΔE2 = 46.6 ± 0.7 K. Quantum tunneling onsets below ~35 K, explaining the narrow hysteresis despite the high thermal barrier.
